# Bench Tariff: Expedited Handling Rush Shares, Out-of-Hours Charges and Notice Hours

The Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service carries, for each service level, a rush share for expedited handling expressed as a percentage of the authorised bench total, a flat charge for holding the bench open out of hours to finish the work, and the hours of notice the workshop needs before expedited handling can be promised.

| Level figure | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rush share for expedited handling, percent of the authorised bench total | 35 | 30 | 30 | 25 | 25 | 0 |
| Flat charge for holding the bench open out of hours, USD | 0.00 | 125.00 | 185.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 450.00 |
| Notice the workshop needs before expedited handling can be promised, hours | 48 | 24 | 48 | 96 | 120 | 12 |

## Footnotes

1. The rush share is the level's surcharge for expedited handling, as a percentage of the authorised bench total. Atelier White-Glove Service carries a rush share of 0 percent.
2. The out-of-hours charge is a flat amount in USD for holding the bench open out of hours to finish the work. Standard Bench Service, Heritage Restoration Service and Designer Authorized Repair Service carry 0.00 USD.
3. The notice figure is the number of hours before the piece is needed by which the workshop must have the request for expedited handling to be able to promise it: 12 hours at Atelier White-Glove Service, 120 hours at Designer Authorized Repair Service.

## Hypothetical readings

A hypothetical request for expedited handling on a Priority Bench Service order made 30 hours before the piece is needed gives the workshop at least the level's 24 hours of notice; the same request 20 hours before does not. A hypothetical Master Jeweler Service order finished out of hours carries the level's flat 185.00 USD out-of-hours charge; the same finish on a Heritage Restoration Service order carries 0.00 USD.
